paragraphs: Wastequip supplies waste handling equipment to businesses across North America. Facilities in the United States, Mexico and Canada support that footprint.

The compactor line runs from apartment and stationary units to short-pack, vertical and self-contained models, plus pre-crushers and cardboard balers. Commercial dumpsters come in front-load and rear-load options along with recycling dumpsters in various sizes. Split dumpsters keep waste and recycling materials separate in one unit. Environmental containers include sealed and unsealed dewatering boxes, shells, vacuum boxes, freight containers and roll-off ramps.

Equipment is sold under brands including Amrep, ConFab, Galbreath and Mountain Tarp. A parts division supplies OEM-guaranteed components and post-sale support. Buyers can purchase equipment, trucks and parts and receive service from a single resource. Pages for environmental containers name hazardous waste management among the applications.
